optimizedDescription.value: Define default SQLite `GraphStore`: atomic persistence, FTS identity search, schema migration, and incremental indexing state.

optimizedContext.value:
# SQLite Graph Store
## Rules
- `SQLiteGraphStore` implements `GraphStore`; backend id `sqlite`, default absent `graphStoreId`; native binding deferred to `open()`; `close()` idempotent.
- DB/WAL/shared memory `{configPath}/graph`; scratch `{configPath}/tmp`; create dirs. `recreate()` discards owned graph artifacts, rotates `storage.epoch`, rebuilds clean generation.
- Persist `File`, `Symbol`, `Spec`, `Document`, `Meta`; relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; `COVERS_SYMBOL` preserves stale metadata.
- FTS5 `symbol_fts` (`name`, `comment`), `spec_fts` (`title`, `description`, `content`), `document_fts` (`path`, `content`); trigram source-content index. `MATCH` remains candidate retrieval, never plain whole-query `LIKE`; persisted `File` content not separate searchable category.
- Sanitized expanded query tokens joined `OR`; add identity candidates. SQL ranks canonical exact > non-exact identity (token/prefix/suffix/component/substring) > BM25 content; more identity-token matches wins. Snippets 1-based ranges.
- `upsertFile`, `removeFile`, `upsertSpec`, `removeSpec`, bulk mutations atomic. One indexing run: one transaction, set-based endpoints, bounded prepared/bulk inserts, one commit, one semantic/content FTS rebuild; no chunk rebuild.
- Persist indexed-input observations, workspace/global latches, VCS evidence, compact unchanged-file facts; structured workspace/surface/name/symbol-space/owner/member-form/exported-name indexed for semantic lookup, never parse/substr-rank canonical ids.
- Shared complete/raw/expanded source query plan filters before limits; deterministic output; bounded <3-char fallback. Code Graph verifies occurrences, suppression, per-file caps. Batched reverse coverage set-based/deduped/deterministic.
- Schema upgrade exactly once (normally `5`→`6`); incompatible reads reject; `graph index` destructively rebuilds, rotates `storage.epoch`, rebuilds FTS before ready.
## Constraints
- Infrastructure adapter; consumers use `code-graph:graph-store`.
- `sqlite` stable backend id; all artifacts rooted `configPath`.
